description: Skill manifest agreement corpus. valid: SkillParser accepts and the schema validates. invalid: SkillParser refuses with code at field (null for the document); schema true means docs/contracts/skill.schema.json also rejects it, false means the schema cannot express the refusal (it accepts the document, or the text is not plain JSON). Each case gives a manifest object or raw text.

invalid.name: requiring and conflicting with one skill
